boundary: This registry describes SCRIMED's locally implemented, synthetic/no-PHI platform foundations and evidence paths. It does not authorize PHI, autonomous clinical care, diagnosis, treatment, prescribing, payer submission, EHR writeback, medical-device connectivity, production deployment, certification claims, customer activation, investor outreach, valuation claims, or revenue guarantees.

coreWedge.boundary: No live PHI, payer submission, EHR writeback, clinical authority, outcome guarantee, or customer activation.

portfolioRationalization.name: Workflow Intelligence Assessment
portfolioRationalization.rationale: Lowest-risk path to paid discovery, buyer evidence, and a measurable follow-on pilot without requiring PHI or production connectors.
portfolioRationalization.buyer: Health-system operations, access, RCM, documentation, and transformation leaders.
portfolioRationalization.nextMilestone: Complete three buyer-specific synthetic rehearsals with baseline, acceptance rubric, reviewer burden, and expansion gate.
portfolioRationalization.retainedBoundary: No live data, payer submission, production connector, clinical outcome, or ROI claim.

portfolioRationalization.name: Governed Synthetic Evaluation
portfolioRationalization.rationale: Turns platform safety and verification into a reviewable service while collecting product-fit and workflow evidence.
portfolioRationalization.buyer: Innovation, clinical informatics, security, governance, and procurement teams.
portfolioRationalization.nextMilestone: Package exact scope, price floor, acceptance criteria, delivery capacity, and evidence-room index.
portfolioRationalization.retainedBoundary: No certification, clinical validation, production readiness, or customer-go-live claim.

portfolioRationalization.name: Protected Workflow Pilots
portfolioRationalization.rationale: Best route to outcome and renewal evidence after identity, migration, tenant, security, and reviewer gates are independently satisfied.
portfolioRationalization.buyer: Qualified health-system, clinic, payer, and research pilot sponsors.
portfolioRationalization.nextMilestone: Close named review, leaked-password protection, disposable migration evidence, and exact-candidate preview validation.
portfolioRationalization.retainedBoundary: No customer activation, PHI, live clinical execution, payer action, or production writeback.

portfolioRationalization.name: Clinical and Patient Experience Catalog
portfolioRationalization.rationale: Preserve compelling role-specific demonstrations while concentrating commercialization on one measurable workflow wedge.
portfolioRationalization.buyer: Clinicians, care teams, patient-access leaders, and executive sponsors.
portfolioRationalization.nextMilestone: Select only the modules required for each buyer story and retire unsupported claims, not reusable infrastructure.
portfolioRationalization.retainedBoundary: Synthetic demonstration only; no diagnosis, treatment, monitoring, clinical authority, or patient-specific action.

portfolioRationalization.name: Agent and Partner Marketplace
portfolioRationalization.rationale: Potential distribution leverage is real, but admission, liability, security, quality, and commercial controls are not externally approved.
portfolioRationalization.buyer: Future technology, implementation, data, and model partners.
portfolioRationalization.nextMilestone: Validate one read-only partner adapter through conformance, security, legal, rollback, and operator review.
portfolioRationalization.retainedBoundary: No public marketplace, partner certification, revenue share, or inherited clinical authority.

strategicMetrics.name: Verified intelligence yield
strategicMetrics.formula: verified outputs accepted by a qualified reviewer / all attempted outputs
strategicMetrics.numerator: Count of outputs passing mandatory verification and receiving the required human disposition.
strategicMetrics.denominator: Count of all bounded output attempts, including failures, abstentions, retries, and rejections.
strategicMetrics.blockedInterpretation: Not clinical accuracy, customer impact, production reliability, or a universal model score.

strategicMetrics.name: Healthcare value returned
strategicMetrics.formula: reviewed operational, financial, patient, and clinical value evidenced / total verified workflow cost
strategicMetrics.numerator: Approved baseline-to-observed value supported by outcome evidence and attributable workflow records.
strategicMetrics.denominator: Inference, retrieval, infrastructure, retry, reviewer-time, failure, and maintenance cost for verified work.
strategicMetrics.blockedInterpretation: Not an ROI, savings, revenue, reimbursement, clinical-outcome, or valuation guarantee.

strategicMetrics.name: Cost per verified successful task
strategicMetrics.formula: total effective workflow cost / verified successful tasks
strategicMetrics.numerator: Provider, hosting, retrieval, validation, review, retry, latency, and failure cost.
strategicMetrics.denominator: Tasks meeting mandatory policy, evidence, quality, and human-acceptance criteria.
strategicMetrics.blockedInterpretation: Not token price, provider leaderboard rank, margin guarantee, or audited cost evidence.
